items.title: Ed Allen Interview, 1961-01-14
items.q: Oh yeah I've heard of him.

ctx.x: Yeah I'd stand on the boat before I did and say let's stand on the boat, let's make them play, and I'd play like that.

What were some of the other trumpet players you liked a whole lot? One boy from my home, Charlie Crick, I liked him great. Charlie who? Charlie Crick. Oh yeah I've heard of him. He played blues with him, beautiful tones. Did he ever record do you know?

I don't know. I think he recorded years in St. Louis. Okay people went around to different cities around that time and used to take their equipment and have their local fans record. I think he recorded a lot. And after he was in Chicago I don't know whether he didn't record or not. But at that time he was in St. Louis, he was very popular. He was a terrible trumpet player. Beautiful tone and he could play the blues. Did he use a mute? No he used to feature the dirt and most of them used to mute. He used to mute.…
